Western Railway RRC Announces Apprentice Trainee Recruitment for 2026

29 Oct 2026, 11:01 AM IST · GlobeWire Daily Public Services Desk · Source: sarkarikyp.com

3 min read

Key takeawaysOfficial source: Western Railway RRC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 – SarkariKyp.com

Overview

Western Railway’s Recruitment Cell (RRC) has posted an official notification inviting applications for the Apprentice Trainee position for the year 2026. The call is being made through the railway’s dedicated recruitment portal and follows the standard online application process used for similar railway apprenticeships.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Age: Candidates must be between 15 and 24 years of age at the time of application. This range is explicitly mentioned in the notification.
  • Educational Qualification: Applicants must have completed 10th standard and hold a valid ITI (Industrial Training Institute) certificate. No other academic qualifications are listed.
  • Document Requirements: As per the notice, applicants will need to upload scanned copies of identity and qualification documents, such as Aadhaar card, 10th mark sheet, and ITI certificate.

Application Process

  1. Download Notification: Prospective candidates should first download the full recruitment notification from the official Western Railway RRC website.
  2. Register & Fill Form: After registration, the online form must be completed with accurate personal and educational details.
  3. Document Upload: Required documents (Aadhaar, mark sheets, certificates) must be scanned and uploaded in the prescribed format.
  4. Fee Payment: An application fee of INR 100 is payable online. The fee is waived for candidates belonging to SC/ST, women, and persons with disabilities (PwD).
  5. Submission: The completed application must be submitted before the deadline stated in the notification; late submissions will not be considered.

Selection Procedure

The notification indicates that selection will be based on an examination. No further details about the exam pattern, syllabus, or number of vacancies have been disclosed in the publicly available notice.

Practical Implications

  • Career Path: An apprenticeship with Indian Railways typically provides on‑the‑job training, exposure to railway operations, and a pathway to permanent positions after successful completion of the program.
  • Comparison with Other Schemes: Similar apprentice posts are offered by other railway zones (e.g., Central, Eastern). While the eligibility criteria (10th + ITI) are common across zones, fee exemptions for reserved categories and women are standard practice.
  • What Is Confirmed vs. Unknown:
  • *Confirmed*: Age limit, educational requirement, fee structure, online application mode, and that selection will be exam‑based.
  • *Unknown*: Exact number of vacancies, application deadline, exam date, detailed syllabus, and any subsequent interview or training phases.

How to Verify the Information

All the details above are drawn from the official recruitment notification posted on Western Railway’s RRC portal. Interested applicants should consult the original notice for the most up‑to‑date information and for any additional instructions.
